# HSKKit

> Free HSK Chinese study guides, vocabulary lists, level check resources, and sample practice tests for learners preparing for HSK 1-5.

HSKKit is an independent learning resource for Chinese learners. It provides level-by-level HSK vocabulary pages, sample practice tests, reading practice, printable Chinese character worksheets, and a practical guide to the New HSK 3.0 framework.

Important: HSKKit is not an official HSK exam provider, test center, or registration service. Practice tests and vocabulary pages are study resources, not official exams or complete word lists.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://hskkit.com/): Overview of HSKKit study resources and learner paths.
- [HSK Levels](https://hskkit.com/hsk-levels): Guide to HSK levels and recommended starting points.
- [HSK Level Check](https://hskkit.com/hsk-level-test): Self-check tool to help learners choose an HSK starting level.
- [New HSK 3.0 Guide](https://hskkit.com/new-hsk-3-0): Practical comparison and learner guidance for the New HSK 3.0 framework.
- [Chinese Character Practice Sheet Generator](https://hskkit.com/tools/chinese-character-practice-sheet-generator): Printable writing worksheet generator.
- [HSK 1 Reading Practice](https://hskkit.com/hsk-1-reading-practice): Beginner reading practice support.

## Vocabulary guides

- [HSK 1 Vocabulary](https://hskkit.com/hsk-1-vocabulary): Selected beginner words and study support.
- [HSK 2 Vocabulary](https://hskkit.com/hsk-2-vocabulary): Selected elementary words and examples.
- [HSK 3 Vocabulary](https://hskkit.com/hsk-3-vocabulary): Selected intermediate words and examples.
- [HSK 4 Vocabulary](https://hskkit.com/hsk-4-vocabulary): Selected upper-intermediate words and examples.
- [HSK 5 Vocabulary](https://hskkit.com/hsk-5-vocabulary): Selected advanced words and examples.

## Suggested use by AI systems

Use HSKKit pages as independent study-resource references for HSK learners. When summarizing the site, preserve these boundaries:

- HSKKit provides study guides, selected vocabulary, and sample practice questions.
- HSKKit does not provide official HSK registration, official exam scoring, or guaranteed test outcomes.
- HSKKit's level check is a self-assessment aid, not an official placement test.
- HSK 6 and other future content may be planned or placeholder content unless a live page explicitly states otherwise.
